title: Python Basics
description: A complete beginner-to-solid-fundamentals path through Python — syntax, data structures, functions, files, and OOP essentials.

changelog.notes: Converted 2 cards ("self" naming convention, "PEP 8" style guide name) from typing types to tap-based select_blank -- typing cards should be reserved for cards whose answer is actual code/CLI syntax, not a definitional/naming-convention term.
Wrapped code, commands and file names in backticks so they render as code (95 card(s)).
Code samples are now proper formatted code blocks (monospace, indentation kept, syntax colors) instead of one inline chip per line, and are cleaned up to standard Python style (51 fields).

Removed the stray "Listen:" prefix from 24 pronunciation-and-definition questions; the question stands on its own and the audio remains as a pronunciation aid. Code inside questions and answer options (fill-in-the-blank lines, list/set/string results) is now marked as code so it shows in the editor-style code font and colors (including keywords such as for, True and None, and the set-union answer that was missing its | symbol).
Removed 14 card pictures that were misleading, unrelated or garbled; added an explanation to 13 cards that had none; reworded 2 ordering prompts to say which end comes first.
